analysis_scope.dataset: Training set (first 30 images) - SMALL, NON-REPRESENTATIVE SAMPLE, used only to select example images for Grad-CAM visualization
analysis_scope.note: These counts describe only this 30-image sample and must not be read as the model's overall false-positive/false-negative rate. The verified test-set confusion matrices (Exercise 3.6 / exercise_3_6_evaluation_report.json, 3,600 images) are: pedestrian FP=885 FN=365 (recall 0.483); traffic_light FP=146 FN=44 (recall 0.983); vehicle FP=65 FN=411 (recall 0.848).

findings.scope_caveat: This 30-image sample is too small to characterize model behavior; it exists only to source example images for Grad-CAM visualization in this exercise.
findings.grad_cam_effective: Grad-CAM heatmaps on the sampled failure cases are visually interpretable
findings.overall_model_readiness: NOT assessed by this task - see Exercise 3.6/4.7 for the actual, statistically meaningful evaluation, which shows the pedestrian model failing its recall requirement (0.483 vs 0.90 threshold)
